description: PLAYING-STYLE REACH FOR OVERLAPS (offball). Two re-aims that widen the two constants a full-back's playing style already keys off, so the DATA lever (giving a full-back the Offensive Full-back style, bit 16 of player+0xCC) buys more. (A) at attack level 2 an Offensive Full-back may overlap from x >= -10 m instead of the halfway line that everyone else gets; -10 -> -20 m. (B) for a candidate WIDER than the carrier the carrier's facing cone is 120 deg (180 deg for Offensive Full-backs); 120 -> 150 deg so plain full-backs benefit too. Affects every AI-controlled player on both teams. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/overlap-style-reach.json

patches.name: A: Offensive Full-back level-2 x gate -10 m -> -20 m
B: carrier facing cone for a wider candidate 120 deg -> 150 deg
